LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_LMG.label: pipe LMG
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_LMG.description: A crudely made gas-operated light machine gun. It has long bursts of fire, but will jam frequently. It also includes a bayonet attachment for short range combat.
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_LMG.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_LMG.tools.bayonet.label: bayonet
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Pistol.label: pipe autopistol
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Pistol.description: A crudely made blowback-operated self-loading pistol. It's quick to fire, but jams quite often.
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Pistol.tools.grip.label: grip
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Pistol.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Revolver.label: pipe revolver
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Revolver.description: A crudely made double-action revolver. It packs a punch, but jams quite often.
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Revolver.tools.grip.label: grip
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Rifle.label: pipe rifle
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Rifle.description: A crudely made bolt-action rifle. It has great range and damage, but jams quite frequently.
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Rifle.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Rifle.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Shotgun.label: pipe shotgun
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Shotgun.description: An crude shotgun that emits a tight-packed spray of pellets. Deadly, but it can jam quite often.
LanguageData.Milkwater_Pipe_Shotgun.tools.stock.label: stock
